'''Jawa Jawa''' was a stall in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. A [[Color|green]] upside down sign spelled out the business' name in [[Aurebesh]], with one word being a mirror image of the other. A bluish-white sign of the same design could be seen on another stall, which also carried the Aurebesh letter [[Senth]] (S).<ref name="Kenobi" /> It shared its name with the [[Jawa]] [[species]] from [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Ep IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
